name: Radial Dual Contouring
definition: RadialDC is a method for large scale world mesh generation that divides space into voxels and uses density functions to determine, place, and connect vertices. It extends Dual Contouring with Dynamic Voxel Sizing and Dynamic Voxel Density Evaluation.
summary: Radial Dual Contouring is a large-scale mesh generation method that adapts voxel resolution and density complexity based on distance from the player to solve performance bottlenecks.
